procedure_column: Chernonozhkin et al. 2021 (Chem Geol 562) Pallasite olivine Line scan (Run 1: major) + Spot (Run 2: trace) [Multi-run] ns-LA-SF-ICP-MS Ghent University

Procedure Name.cell: Chernonozhkin et al. (2021) Pallasite Olivine Multi-run Spot/Transect v1
Procedure Name.value: Chernonozhkin et al. (2021) Pallasite Olivine Multi-run Spot/Transect v1

Procedure Author.cell: Chernonozhkin, Pittarello, Goderis, Vanhaecke et al.
Procedure Author.value: Chernonozhkin, Pittarello, Goderis, Vanhaecke et al.

Laboratory.cell: Dept. of Chemistry, Atomic & Mass Spectrometry, Ghent University, Belgium
Laboratory.value: Dept. of Chemistry, Atomic & Mass Spectrometry, Ghent University, Belgium

Funding Source for Procedure Development.cell: N — the BELSPO, FWO, BOF-UGent and Humboldt support is for the study as a whole and is recorded under Funding Source for Analysis

Procedure Reference(s).cell: Chernonozhkin et al. (2021) Chem. Geol. 562; Liu et al. (2008) for IS method
Procedure Reference(s).value: Chernonozhkin et al. (2021) Chem. Geol. 562; Liu et al. (2008) for IS method

Sampling Unit Type.cell: Grain (individual olivine crystal) > Region of interest (line scan) — "a second line-scan was completed on top of the first one, using a laser spot of 130 μm diameter ... and a translation speed of 10 μm s−1" (p.3)
Sampling Unit Type.value: Grain (individual olivine crystal) > Region of interest (line scan)

Pre-Ablation Surface Treatment.cell: Pre-ablation before each analysis: 2 J/cm², 20 Hz, 150 µm square-masked spot, 300 µm/s — 'to avoid bias in the trace element concentrations due to re-deposition of ablated sample material after previous analyses' (§2.2.3)
Pre-Ablation Surface Treatment.value: Pre-ablation before each analysis: 2 J/cm², 20 Hz, 150 µm square-masked spot, 300 µm/s

Sampling Unit Selection Criteria.cell: Position relative to the metal-olivine rim — the line scans run "from the olivine rim in the direction of the olivine core" on large olivine crystals sited from the μXRF maps (p.4); the surface is pre-ablated before each analysis (p.3)
Sampling Unit Selection Criteria.value: Position relative to the metal-olivine rim

Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening.cell: μXRF mapping of larger sections, on which the ablation is sited — Fe Kα intensity maps identify the mineral phases "based on the intensities of the Kα lines of the constituent major elements (Fe, Mg, Ni, Cr, S, Ca and P)", and the LA-ICP-MS areas correspond "to the locations indicated on the larger μXRF maps as black rectangles" (p.4). The instrument is a Bruker M4 Tornado with a Rh-anode source at 50 kV and 150 μA, focused to "a 25 μm spot (measured for Mo Kα)" (p.3)
Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening.value: μXRF mapping of larger sections, on which the ablation is sited

Laser Manufacturer & Model.cell: Teledyne CETAC Technologies Analyte G2 (193 nm ArF excimer)
Laser Manufacturer & Model.value: Teledyne CETAC Technologies Analyte G2 (193 nm ArF excimer)

Interface Cone Configuration.cell: Al standard sample cone (1.1 mm aperture); Al H-type skimmer (0.8 mm aperture)
Interface Cone Configuration.value: Al standard sample cone (1.1 mm aperture); Al H-type skimmer (0.8 mm aperture)

Laser Spot Geometry.cell: run 1: 30 µm diameter circular-masked; run 2: 130 µm diameter — §2.2.3

Laser Spot Path / Ablation Mode.cell: run 1: line scan, 400 µm; run 2: line scan on top of run 1, 400 µm — 'a second line-scan was completed on top of the first one' (§2.2.3)

value.value: line scan on top of run 1, 400 µm

Ablation Duration per Spot.cell: 50 s of sample ablation per 400 µm line, both runs — Table B1
Ablation Duration per Spot.value: 50 s of sample ablation per 400 µm line, both runs

Raster Line Spacing (Mapping Only).cell: N/A — line scan + spot; not 2D mapping

Carrier Gas and Flow Rate.cell: He: MFC-1 0.19 l min⁻¹; MFC-2 0.22 l min⁻¹
Carrier Gas and Flow Rate.value: He: MFC-1 0.19 l min⁻¹; MFC-2 0.22 l min⁻¹

Make-up Gas and Flow Rate.cell: Ar, 0.947 L/min (both runs) — Table B1; no N2 added

RF Power.cell: 1000 W (run 1 major elements + run 2 trace elements)
RF Power.value: 1000 W (run 1 major elements + run 2 trace elements)

Plasma Thermal Mode.cell: N — RF power 1000 W for both runs (Table B1); only the mapping is described as cool plasma

Analysis Sequence.cell: MPI-DING and USGS reference materials at the start and end of each analytical session; every analysis carried out 3 times — §2.2.3
Analysis Sequence.value: MPI-DING and USGS reference materials at the start and end of each analytical session; every analysis carried out 3 times

Target Species.cell: Mg, Si, P, Ca, Cr, Mn, Fe, Li, Sc, V, Co, Ni, Cu, Zn, Y, Zr, Nb, Cs, Ba, La, Ce, Pr, Nd, Sm, Eu, Gd, Tb, Dy, Ho, Er, Tm, Yb, Lu, Hf, Ta, W, Re, Ir, Pt, Au, Th, U — run 1 measures Mg, Si, P, Ca, Cr, Mn, Fe; run 2 the 36 trace and minor elements (§2.2.3)

Monitored Masses.key: defines: monitored property per target species
Monitored Masses.cell: ²⁵Mg → Mg; ²⁹Si → Si; ³¹P → P; ⁴⁴Ca → Ca; ⁵³Cr → Cr; ⁵⁵Mn → Mn; ⁵⁷Fe → Fe; ⁷Li → Li; ⁴⁵Sc → Sc; ⁵¹V → V; ⁵⁹Co → Co; ⁶⁰Ni → Ni; ⁶³Cu → Cu; ⁶⁶Zn → Zn; ⁸⁹Y → Y; ⁹⁰Zr → Zr; ⁹³Nb → Nb; ¹³³Cs → Cs; ¹³⁷Ba → Ba; ¹³⁹La → La; ¹⁴⁰Ce → Ce; ¹⁴¹Pr → Pr; ¹⁴⁵Nd → Nd; ¹⁴⁷Sm → Sm; ¹⁵³Eu → Eu; ¹⁵⁸Gd → Gd; ¹⁵⁹Tb → Tb; ¹⁶⁴Dy → Dy; ¹⁶⁵Ho → Ho; ¹⁶⁰Er → Er; ¹⁶⁹Tm → Tm; ¹⁷⁴Yb → Yb; ¹⁷⁵Lu → Lu; ¹⁸⁰Hf → Hf; ¹⁸¹Ta → Ta; ¹⁸²W → W; ¹⁸⁵Re → Re; ¹⁹³Ir → Ir; ¹⁹⁵Pt → Pt; ¹⁹⁷Au → Au; ²³²Th → Th; ²³⁸U → U — run 1: '25Mg, 29Si, 31P, 44Ca, 53Cr, 55Mn and 57Fe'; run 2: 36 nuclides (§2.2.3), ⁵³Cr also in run 2 (Table B1)

Reported Variables and Units.cell: Mg, Si, P, Ca, Cr, Mn, Fe, Li, Sc, V, Co, Ni, Cu, Zn, Y, Zr, Nb, Cs, Ba, La, Ce, Pr, Nd, Sm, Eu, Gd, Tb, Dy, Ho, Er, Tm, Yb, Lu, Hf, Ta, W, Re, Ir, Pt, Au, Th, U (µg/g); Fa# — Table 1, 'the average from 3 replicate measurements'

Mass Resolution Assignment.cell: run 1: medium resolution (M/ΔM = 4000); run 2: low resolution (M/ΔM = 300) — §2.2.3

Dwell Time per Mass.cell: all: 0.01 s sample time — run 1: 18 samples per peak, duty cycle 2.069 s; run 2: 7 samples per peak, 2.062 s (Table B1)

Background Count Time.cell: 5 gas-blank scans and 24 ablation scans per analysis, both runs; 10 s of blank per run — Table B1
Background Count Time.value: 5 gas-blank scans and 24 ablation scans per analysis, both runs; 10 s of blank per run

Inter-Pass Data Dependency.cell: run 1: N/A; run 2: normalised to the Cr concentration from run 1 — 'The Cr concentrations calculated from this run were then used for internal standardization to normalize the data of the second, trace element run' (§2.2.3)

value.value: normalised to the Cr concentration from run 1

Number of Replicates.cell: 3 — 'Every analysis was carried out 3 times' (§2.2.3); Table B1 '400 µm lines, n = 3'

Acquisition Pass.cell: run 1 (major elements); run 2 (trace elements) — two line-scans on the same 400 µm line, each after pre-ablation; 'Every analysis was carried out 3 times' (§2.2.3)

Internal Standard Approach.cell: run 1: sum normalization of the oxides to 100 wt% (Liu et al., 2008); run 2: single element from run 1 — §2.2.3, App. C2

value.value: sum normalization of the oxides to 100 wt% (Liu et al., 2008)

Internal Standard Element.cell: run 1: none (oxide sum); run 2: Cr (concentration from run 1) — §2.2.3

Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach.cell: Surface-impurity spikes removed with a 3 sigma filter; results with significant spikes not included in Table 1; Pb and U not presented because of multiple spikes — §3.3
Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach.value: Surface-impurity spikes removed with a 3 sigma filter; results with significant spikes not included in Table 1; Pb and U not presented because of multiple spikes

Blank / Background Correction Method.cell: Gas blank before each line analysis; the average background preceding each analysis subtracted — App. C5
Blank / Background Correction Method.value: Gas blank before each line analysis; the average background preceding each analysis subtracted

Pulse/Analog Detector Nonlinearity Corre.cell: N — 'Triple' detection (Table B1); at the 130 µm spot, major elements saturate the detector 'even when using the triple detection mode' (App. C2)

Spectral Interference Corrections Applie.cell: No mathematical correction — interferences present at all times are 'corrected by background subtraction'; others are partly accounted for by similar concentrations in the calibration standards (App. C4)

Interfering Species.cell: N — Table C1 lists interferences on the mapping nuclides; none is listed for the line-scan runs

Memory Effect Mitigation.cell: 11 s of washout per run — Table B1

Normalization / Standards-Based Correcti.cell: N — the normalisation is the internal standardisation (Internal Standard Approach)

Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.cell: N — whole results are dropped, but on signal grounds: "where significant spikes in individual transient LA-ICP-MS signals were observed (e.g. Ca in CMS 04071 and Seymchan and Ni in Brahin and Seymchan), results were not included in Table 1" (p.6). By basis that belongs to Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach; no result-based selection rule is stated

Combination Method.cell: all: average of 3 replicate measurements — Table 1: 'The results shown are the average from 3 replicate measurements'

Primary Calibration Standard Name.cell: all [all: NIST SRM 612, NIST SRM 614, USGS GSD-1G, USGS GSE-1G, BHVO-2G, BIR-1G, KL2-G, ML3B-G, StHs6/80-G, T1-G, ATHO-G, BM90/21-G, GOR128-G, GOR132-G] — for both runs, 'repeatedly measured with the corresponding laser settings' (App. C2)

value.value: NIST SRM 612, NIST SRM 614, USGS GSD-1G, USGS GSE-1G, BHVO-2G, BIR-1G, KL2-G, ML3B-G, StHs6/80-G, T1-G, ATHO-G, BM90/21-G, GOR128-G, GOR132-G

Calibration Standard Measurement Frequen.cell: Start and end of each analytical session — 'MPI-DING and USGS reference materials were measured at the start and end of each analytical session' (§2.2.3)
Calibration Standard Measurement Frequen.value: Start and end of each analytical session

Detection Limit.cell: Cu: 0.28 ng/g; Cs: 4.9 ng/g; Ba: 16 ng/g; W: 5.4 ng/g; Re: 0.42 ng/g; Ir: 0.95 ng/g; Pt: 0.73 ng/g; Au: 1.8 ng/g; Nb: 0.61 ng/g; other: Table 1 — stated in §3.3; LODs averaged over analyses (Na = 24, Nb = 5). §3.3 also gives 33 ng/g for Sr, which is not among the measured nuclides

Detection Limit Method.cell: all: Longerich et al. (1996), LOD = 3SD/S × √(1/Nb + 1/Na) — Na = 24 and Nb = 5 (App. C5)

Limit of Quantification (LOQ) Method.cell: all: as the LOD, with 10 SD instead of 3 SD — App. C5

value.value: as the LOD, with 10 SD instead of 3 SD

Counting Statistics Error.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Internal (Within-Measurement) Analytical.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Additional Notes.cell: Two line-scan runs on the same line after pre-ablation: run 1 (30 µm, medium resolution) gives the major elements and Cr, which normalises run 2 (130 µm, low resolution) for the trace elements (§2.2.3, App. C2)
Additional Notes.value: Two line-scan runs on the same line after pre-ablation: run 1 (30 µm, medium resolution) gives the major elements and Cr, which normalises run 2 (130 µm, low resolution) for the trace elements (§2.2.3, App. C2)
